title: Developer Advocate
summary: Developer advocates help software developers learn and succeed with a product, usually an API, SDK, database or developer tool. They sit between engineering, product and marketing, writing code samples and tutorials, speaking at events and bringing developer feedback back to the product team.
dailyDuties: Write tutorials, blog posts and getting-started guides
Build sample apps and demos in public repositories
Speak at meetups, conferences and webinars
Answer developer questions in forums and community channels
Report developer pain points to product and engineering
Review and improve API docs and SDK examples

skills.expectation: Represent the product to developers through talks, community work and feedback to the product team
Write sample code and demos in at least one popular language

Maintain public sample repositories and review community pull requests
Build demos and sample apps that show real use cases
Plan blog and video content with the marketing team
Build AI-powered demos with LLM APIs
Edit documentation sites kept in Git
Bring developer feedback to product and engineering teams

certifications.why: Shows comfort with GitHub workflows used in open-source samples
Helps when demos run on cloud services
